subject: Oxbridge pilot pause — proposal to resume with surge credit
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@oxbridge.ai>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@oxbridge.ai
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Oxbridge pilot pause — quick note

Connor —

Thanks for the check-in. We had to pause the evaluation last week because one of our main use cases hit a compliance hold (internal change management). We still want to move forward, but we need a short runway to validate the revised ingest pipeline. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a short surge of capacity and/or credits to help us re-start for ~10 business days? If possible we'd like to avoid a full re-contract until we validate throughput.

Also looping in procurement for any SOW/terms adjustments.

— Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of AI Integrations | Oxbridge AI
alex.j@oxbridge.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@oxbridge.ai>, procurement@oxbridge.ai
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Oxbridge pilot pause — proposal to resume with surge credit

Alex — thanks for the context and for looping procurement. We can definitely put together a short, time-boxed restart. Two quick options that should be low friction:

1) Two-week surge credit: we provision a burst pool and credit your account for up to 500k token-equivalent usage over 10 business days. No contract amendment required; if you convert to a paid Dedicated or Reserved pilot after validation we can roll credit into the first invoice.

2) Short SOW addendum: a 30-day addendum with a small committed token bucket at a discounted unit price (5% off list) and a one-time implementation window. This would require a simple DocuSign addendum but provides guaranteed capacity.

I'm attaching a usage snapshot from your paused run to help size the surge (usage_snapshot_20260708.csv). If you prefer, we can also do a hybrid (small committed bucket + credits for spikes).

Quick ask: which option would procurement prefer? If you want me to, I can route a concise SOW addendum and copy Marissa & Neha for approval.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai | (510) 555-0123

Attachment: usage_snapshot_20260708.csv (CSV, 12KB)
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2026 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Oxbridge pilot pause — proposal to resume with surge credit

Marissa / Neha —

Forwarding Alex's note. Oxbridge wants a short runway to revalidate after their pipeline change. They asked specifically for a 10-business-day restart. I proposed either a two-week surge credit (no amendment) or a 30-day SOW addendum at 5% off list.

Usage snapshot attached. Key numbers: their paused run peaked at ~1.2M tokens/day during tests; typical steady is ~250–400k/day. My read: 500k token credit should cover validation spikes and keep us comfortable on capacity.

Can you confirm (1) approval for a one-off 500k token credit (non-recoupable unless they convert) and (2) if legal needs to review a short addendum for option 2? If Marissa signs off I can send the credit confirmation + SOW draft to procurement.

Thanks —
Connor

Attachment: usage_snapshot_20260708.csv
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Oxbridge pilot pause — proposal to resume with surge credit

Connor — good summary. Approve the two-week surge credit (500k token-equivalent) with these guardrails:

- Credit is time-boxed to 10 business days from the first resumed request.
- Credit cannot be applied retroactively.
- If Oxbridge converts to a paid pilot or Dedicated contract within 60 days, we will apply 50% of the unused credit toward the first invoice (to discourage gaming).
- Sales to confirm any capacity guarantees up-front (we can allocate burst nodes but not commit Dedicated throughput unless they sign a reserved plan).

Neha: please confirm if the short SOW addendum needs a legal review for option 2; if not urgent we can stick to the credit route to move faster.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@oxbridge.ai>, procurement@oxbridge.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Oxbridge pilot pause — proposal to resume with surge credit

Alex — thanks, agreed path below. Per Marissa's approval we've provisioned a 10-business-day surge credit: 500,000 token-equivalents available starting when you send your first resumed request (we'll mark the activation on our side). Terms in brief: time-boxed to 10 business days; non-retroactive; if you convert within 60 days we apply 50% of any unused credit to your first invoice. No SOW required for this credit.

I've attached a quick SOW draft only for procurement's visibility in case you prefer the addendum path (Oxbridge_SOW_draft_v2.pdf). Otherwise we'll mark the credit live once you confirm the start date.

Next steps: please reply with the desired start date (we recommend 2026-07-15 to give you a short runway) and procurement contact for billing confirmation.

Thanks — excited to see Oxbridge back in the pipeline.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai | (510) 555-0123
